title: a turn reads the place strings of the person it works
line: the tail of a turn runs the place resolver on the strings behind the person's own events through the geocoder's cache: a geocoder that does not answer is named once, with how many strings it left, and the strings stay as they were (no card, no resolver) for the next turn; once it answers, the strings a unique full match or one territory under two names settles are resolved in the turn, the one it cannot settle is a card on the fact row, and the report says both; the strings of a record the turn brings are read too

steps.say: a turn on the man born at Worcester, paused on the pages to save
resumed with the geocoder silent: the harness has no network and no answer planted

left.has: OpenStreetMap Nominatim (N06) did not answer (the harness has no network) on 5 place strings; they stay unresolved, the next turn asks it again

expect.why: the silent source is named once, with the count of strings it left

place_string.raw: Norristown, Montgomery, Pennsylvania, United States of America

expect.why: a string whose request got no answer is left exactly as it was: no resolver tag, so the next run asks again

place_card.raw: Norristown, Montgomery, Pennsylvania, United States of America

expect.why: and no card says there is nothing to choose from

steps.say: the next turn on him, paused again
resumed with the geocoder's real answers for the five strings behind his events

report.has: places: 4 of 5 new place string(s) resolved by the geocoder's answer

left.has: places: 1 place string(s) the resolver could not settle, a card on the fact row for the owner

expect.why: the turn says how many strings it resolved and how many it left as a card
every request was answered: no source is named as silent

place_string.raw: Norristown, Montgomery, Pennsylvania, United States of America

expect.why: a unique full match is accepted in the turn
a city and the county coterminous with it are one territory

place_card.raw: Worcester, Montgomery County, Pennsylvania, United States of America

expect.why: the township and the village stay the owner's to choose between: a card on the fact row
the birth waits on the owner's answer to its string

steps.say: a turn on him once more, paused: nothing of his own is left for the resolver to read
while it is paused a record is archived for another man, the Massachusetts birth register
resumed with the geocoder's real answer for the register's one place string

report.has: places: 1 of 1 new place string(s) resolved by the geocoder's answer

expect.why: the string the turn's new record brought is resolved in the same turn, though it is no string behind the person's own events
